note: Family-run in-town RV park in Stanley, across from Wilson Park; grass lots with two asphalt parking spaces each. Sells weekly and monthly leases only. --Claude
summary: Operator site posts only $200/week and $700/month (lease agreement with the invoice), 'Monthly and Weekly lots available by reservation', open April-October; full hookups 30/50A. No nightly rate or nightly sale anywhere: drop candidate (weekly minimum / long-stay). Google 4.9 (19).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay / standing minimum): the shortest stay sold is a week. Home page: 'Monthly and Weekly lots available by reservation.' The rates page is titled 'SEASONAL LEASE' and posts only '$700 per month $200 per week'; 'A copy of the lease agreement is included in the invoice.' The park rules address the 'Lessee' and freeze-proofing of water lines. Five tests: (1) lease/monthly character - yes; (2) no nightly rate posted - fails; (3) monthly $700 marketed - yes; (4) nightly share 0 of 14 lots (no nightly sale at all) - fails; (5) wording sells only week/month lots by reservation - fails. Also a standing 7-night minimum all season. The stored note's 'seasonal leases plus nightly transient' is contradicted by the operator.

REVIEWS vs OPERATOR: Google reviews show past short stays: 'Twyla and Jerry went above and beyond to make our one night in Stanley amazing!' (a year ago); 'Would highly recommend if passing through Stanley!' (2 years ago); and a season-long stay: 'We stayed from June to September 2025' (a year ago). The operator's own site now sells weekly and monthly lots only, so a one-night sale may exist by phone/text but is not offered. Reviewer: drop on the operator's posted terms unless AWH wants a call.
PRICE GATE: not computable (no nightly rate). $200 a week works out to about $29 a night but is not a nightly sale.
